mandate_exclusif.title: Exclusive Mandate
mandate_exclusif.intro: MAPA's reference mandate. Maximum mutual commitment, full deployment of our commercial force and confidential channels, preferred rate.
mandate_exclusif.highlight_1_title: One agency, one point of contact
mandate_exclusif.highlight_1_text: Resources concentrated, coordination simplified, consistent commercial narrative.
mandate_exclusif.highlight_2_text: Professional shoot, drone if relevant, editing. Paid option at signing: amount deducted from the commission at the deed, only if MAPA closes the sale.
mandate_exclusif.highlight_3_text: Activation of our qualified database and partners before any public listing.
mandate_exclusif.highlight_4_text: 3% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT) — the most advantageous formula for committed sellers. 2-month renewable term.
mandate_exclusif.service_3: Video Pack as a paid option (shoot + drone + editing)
mandate_exclusif.service_4: Distribution to our qualified database + off-market partners
mandate_exclusif.when_text: You want to sell quickly, properly, and consistently. You appreciate having a single dedicated contact who defends your price and your privacy. Statistically the best-performing mandate — and the most cost-effective.

mandate_semi_exclusif.title: Semi-Exclusive Mandate
mandate_semi_exclusif.intro: You keep your private circle in hand, MAPA mobilises its channels. 4% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT), 2-month renewable term.
mandate_semi_exclusif.highlight_1_text: You can present your property to your own circle, MAPA acts in parallel.
mandate_semi_exclusif.highlight_2_text: Photo, premium distribution. Video Pack as a paid option (deductible if MAPA closes).
mandate_semi_exclusif.highlight_3_title: Fees only if MAPA introduces the buyer
mandate_semi_exclusif.highlight_3_text: You only pay if the sale results from our direct or indirect intervention.
mandate_semi_exclusif.service_3: Distribution to our qualified database + partners
mandate_semi_exclusif.excluded_2: Premium off-market distribution reserved for Exclusive
mandate_semi_exclusif.when_text: You have a circle that may potentially present buyers (family, friends, neighbours, executives) and you want professional support without giving up that possibility. The balanced formula.

mandate_simple.title: Simple Mandate
mandate_simple.intro: For sought-after properties where multiple channels can run in parallel. 5% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT), 2-month renewable term.
mandate_simple.highlight_1_text: You retain full freedom to mandate other professionals.
mandate_simple.highlight_2_text: Listing and moderate channel activation — full marketing investment is reserved for Exclusive.
mandate_simple.highlight_3_text: 5% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT) to offset commercial risk.
mandate_simple.when_text: Your property is highly sought-after and you want to maximise the number of channels active simultaneously, accepting that coordination will be less fluid. Statistically the least performing — but sometimes relevant.

mandate_autonome.title: Autonomous Mandate
mandate_autonome.intro: For sellers who wish to manage viewings and negotiations themselves, but want professional legal and notarial backup. 1% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT), 2-month renewable term.
mandate_autonome.highlight_1_title: You stay in the driver's seat
mandate_autonome.highlight_1_text: Listing, viewings, negotiation: you handle it. We step in on request.
mandate_autonome.highlight_2_text: Compromise, suspensive conditions, notarial coordination — handled by MAPA.
mandate_autonome.highlight_3_text: 1% excl. VAT (+ 17% VAT) for the legal and notarial side only.
mandate_autonome.when_text: You are yourself a professional, an experienced investor, or you already have an identified buyer. You want to secure the legal and notarial side without paying for a full service.

mandate_recherche.title: Search Mandate
mandate_recherche.intro: The European answer to the buyer's agent. You entrust us with the mission of finding and negotiating your future property — in Luxembourg or abroad. Under exclusive mandate, in your sole interest.
mandate_recherche.highlight_1_title: Advice that serves only one master
mandate_recherche.highlight_1_text: We defend exclusively your buyer's interest. No double agency.
mandate_recherche.highlight_2_text: Activation of our network of confidential partners in France, Luxembourg, UAE, Spain, etc.
mandate_recherche.highlight_3_text: Under mandate signed in Luxembourg, we operate as broker in 28 premium cities.
mandate_recherche.highlight_4_text: You only pay if we find and the sale closes. Limited upfront.
mandate_recherche.when_title: When to choose the search mandate
mandate_recherche.when_text: You don't have the time or the network to identify the ideal property yourself, or you are looking abroad (where market opacity is high). You want advice that defends exclusively your interest — not a broker serving two masters.

page_sell.title: Entrust the sale of your property.
page_sell.intro: One rule: consistency. Four formulas to sell according to your level of engagement, and a single method — ours.
page_sell.step_one_text: Visit, audit, market study, presentation price calibration.
page_sell.step_two_text: Tailored mandate signed, professional photos, off-market then public distribution as per strategy.
page_sell.step_three_text: Buyer selection, negotiation, compromise, deed. We stay by your side until the end.
page_sell.estimate_text: Our simulator gives you an indicative range in under 2 minutes. The visit makes it accurate.

page_rent.title: Find, list, manage.
page_rent.intro: Find a rental, list your property, à la carte property management. Always within the 5% rent cap (law of 21 September 2006).
page_rent.find_text: Our Luxembourg and international rental catalogue, continuously updated.
page_rent.list_text: Rigorous tenant selection, full file, AML/KYC, compliant lease.
page_rent.manage_text: Collection, charges, claims, end of lease. A modular formula tailored to your needs.
page_rent.legal_notice: The Luxembourg legal cap is 5% of invested capital per year (law of 21 September 2006). MAPA Property guarantees strict compliance with this rule, which protects both tenant and landlord.

about_page.title: Real estate isn't sold. It's entrusted.
about_page.intro: MAPA Property — Luxembourg real estate agency and international broker. Under mandate, within a framework, in your sole interest.
about_page.para_1: There are transactions that happen in the light. And then there are those that are tied up in silence. For nearly a decade, MAPA Property has operated in the shadow of the most beautiful Luxembourg and international real estate transactions. Few of us know about it. And that's exactly how it should be.
about_page.para_2: It all started in 2018, in the corridors of a demanding financial environment. There, Julien Brebion learned a discipline: precision, discretion, the finely tuned reading of interests. When he founded MAPA Property in 2020 in Luxembourg, those three words became a method.
about_page.para_3: Like the American buyer's agent who has defended the buyer alone for decades, we believe the best real estate service is built on a search mandate. Not a broker serving two masters. Advice that defends only one interest at a time. This American evidence, we have made it our own.
about_page.para_4: We work with the tools of our time. Artificial intelligence is our daily ally — to analyse, structure, anticipate. But it never replaces an advisor's eye in a room. Our craft is the meeting. The rest is just technology.
about_page.para_5: Working together matters. Protecting each party's interests with a clear framework matters more. Signed mandate, defined missions, contractual confidentiality. This is how we build the best partnerships. And it's what explains our effectiveness.
about_page.para_6: We have been here for nearly a decade. We have supported several hundred clients — international families, executives, institutional investors, family offices. Most would tell you they never saw us in the light. That is precisely the service they came looking for.
about_page.para_7: MAPA Property is today a Luxembourg real estate agency and an international broker. We cover 24 municipalities in the Grand Duchy and 28 premium cities worldwide. We operate under mandate, within a framework, and always in our clients' sole interest. We can of course extend our search field on request, depending on our clients' needs and on the partners we may engage — always carefully selected, in full alignment with our standards and our vision of service.
about_page.bio_julien: I am the co-founder of MAPA Property and my role is Real Estate Director and also Exclusive Sourcing Specialist.
